summary: Section A is a high-quality physiology overview: all six active inline citations resolve to whitelisted Tier-1 sources with verified PMIDs and correct first-author surnames (Rothacker 2016 PMID 26735261 and Andersen 2002 PMID 11889165 spot-checked via PubMed), type-tags are correctly assigned throughout, the log-linear TSH↔fT4 relationship and index-of-individuality (0.49) figures match the primary literature, and all five rubric elements are addressed. The sole finding is an orphaned bibliography entry ([7]) that is never referenced inline; it does not affect numerical accuracy or any tag-discipline rule.
